BEGIN DOMAIN
(define (domain termes)
  (:requirements :typing :negative-preconditions)
  (:types numb position)
  (:predicates
    (height ?p - position ?n - numb)
    (at ?p - position)
    (SUCC ?higher - numb ?lower - numb)
    (NEIGHBOR ?p1 - position ?p2 - position)
    (IS-DEPOT ?p - position)
    (has-block)
  )

  ;; Move: stay at same height, move to neighboring position
  (:action move
    :parameters (?from - position ?to - position ?h - numb)
    :precondition (and
      (at ?from)
      (NEIGHBOR ?from ?to)
      (height ?from ?h)
      (height ?to ?h)
    )
    :effect (and
      (not (at ?from))
      (at ?to)
    )
  )

  ;; Move up: new position height is one higher than old
  (:action move-up
    :parameters (?from - position ?to - position ?h1 - numb ?h2 - numb)
    :precondition (and
      (at ?from)
      (NEIGHBOR ?from ?to)
      (height ?from ?h1)
      (height ?to ?h2)
      (SUCC ?h2 ?h1)
    )
    :effect (and
      (not (at ?from))
      (at ?to)
    )
  )

  ;; Move down: new position height is one lower than old
  (:action move-down
    :parameters (?from - position ?to - position ?h1 - numb ?h2 - numb)
    :precondition (and
      (at ?from)
      (NEIGHBOR ?from ?to)
      (height ?from ?h1)
      (height ?to ?h2)
      (SUCC ?h1 ?h2)
    )
    :effect (and
      (not (at ?from))
      (at ?to)
    )
  )

  ;; Place block: robot has block, neighbor position same height, not depot, height increases
  (:action place-block
    :parameters (?rpos - position ?bpos - position ?h - numb ?newh - numb)
    :precondition (and
      (at ?rpos)
      (has-block)
      (NEIGHBOR ?rpos ?bpos)
      (height ?rpos ?h)
      (height ?bpos ?h)
      (not (IS-DEPOT ?bpos))
      (SUCC ?newh ?h)
    )
    :effect (and
      (not (has-block))
      (not (height ?bpos ?h))
      (height ?bpos ?newh)
    )
  )

  ;; Remove block: robot has no block, neighbor position with height one higher, not depot
  (:action remove-block
    :parameters (?rpos - position ?bpos - position ?h - numb ?hhigh - numb)
    :precondition (and
      (at ?rpos)
      (not (has-block))
      (NEIGHBOR ?rpos ?bpos)
      (height ?rpos ?h)
      (height ?bpos ?hhigh)
      (SUCC ?hhigh ?h)
      (not (IS-DEPOT ?bpos))
    )
    :effect (and
      (has-block)
      (not (height ?bpos ?hhigh))
      (height ?bpos ?h)
    )
  )

  ;; Create block at depot: robot gets a block
  (:action create-block
    :parameters (?d - position)
    :precondition (and
      (at ?d)
      (IS-DEPOT ?d)
      (not (has-block))
    )
    :effect (and
      (has-block)
    )
  )

  ;; Destroy block at depot: robot loses its block
  (:action destroy-block
    :parameters (?d - position)
    :precondition (and
      (at ?d)
      (IS-DEPOT ?d)
      (has-block)
    )
    :effect (and
      (not (has-block))
    )
  )
)
END DOMAIN

- (has-block) ; robot has block

Since heights are finite set of numb objects with SUCC relations, we need to ensure there exists next height. So precondition includes (SUCC ?newh ?h).
